commits.message:
feat(export): saveSvg writes Console.exportSvg to a file (rich-export-9a1.4)

saveSvg joins saveText and saveHtml in src/node/save.ts, its options typed
from Console.exportSvg. The themes demo gains EXPORT_SVG, which is what
demonstrates the new export to the coverage gate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(export): Console.exportSvg draws the recording as a terminal window (rich-export-9a1.3) (#242)

* feat(export): Console.exportSvg draws the recording as a terminal window (rich-export-9a1.3)

encodeSvg in src/core/export-svg.ts encodes export-lines' resolved runs as
an SVG: Rich's chrome and geometry, each chunk of a run anchored at its cell
column with textLength set to its cells so a fallback font cannot shift the
row, decorations as rectangles, one class per look, an FNV-1a id prefix so
the same recording exports the same bytes. Markup escaping moves into
export-lines so both encoders share one escaper.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(export): SVG class prefix covers the rules it scopes; markup drops XML-illegal chars (rich-export-9a1.3)

Review pass (high) on PR #242:
- The class prefix hashed only title + text, so one recording under two
  themes inlined on one page shared class names and restyled each other.
  It now hashes the class rules too; the blink keyframes, identical in every
  SVG, take one constant name.
- escapeText/escapeAttribute drop characters XML 1.0 forbids; one of them
  made the whole SVG unparsable.
- One FNV-1a (src/core/fnv1a.ts, UTF-8) replaces the UTF-16 copy in
  export-svg and linkId in osc8.
- Title centred on the window rect, not offset by the margin.
